description: Defines Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes CreateItemDto and UpdateItemDto for item creation and update operations in the backend.

classes.name: CreateItemDto
classes.description: DTO for creating an item, includes Title (required, max 200 chars) and optional Description.

classes.name: UpdateItemDto
classes.description: DTO for updating an item, includes Title (required, max 200 chars) and optional Description.
